text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: p99 latency breach for service=redwood-inference-api (eu-west1). SLO p99 = 250ms currently ~820ms (3.3x). Alert threshold 5m sustained. PagerDuty incident INC-2024-873 opened.

Priya R: seeing a big tail on the hotpath, looks correlated with recent rollout of model v1.12.0 and increased cold starts on the LRU sidecar.

Ethan K: acking on PagerDuty now. `pd ack INC-2024-873`

PagerDuty: INC-2024-873 ACKED by Ethan K.

Sam: quick check — autoscaler metrics show surge in queue_length and GPU busy=100% on pool-inference-eu-west-2. Batching appears to backlog.

Priya R: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-tail. First action: scale up dedicated pool + enable fallthrough to compatible model variant (v1.11-quant).

Ethan K: running `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deploy/inference-service-eu` and bumping autoscaler min to 4 -> 6.

oncall-bot: Command executed by Ethan K: scale replication for inference-service-eu -> 6.

Sam: also seeing high KV cache churn — evictions spiking, maybe due to the new tokenizer. Adding warm cache prefix might help; toggling prefix_caching=true for 1 shard to test.

Priya R: temporarily routing 10% of traffic to v1.11-quant to lower GPU cost and tail latency. Adding temporary traffic-split in routing policy. `redwood route set --service inference --traffic v1.12=90,v1.11-quant=10`

Marta: customers impacted: hosted-api customers in EU (PLG tier) experiencing increased latencies; internal metrics show ~4% increase in client retries and two support tickets flagged high-priority. No broad 5xx spike yet.

Ethan K: latency p99 back down to ~300ms after scale + 10% fallback, still above SLO but trending down. p95 is stable. Monitoring for 5m window.

incident-bot: SLO burn reduced from 3.3x to 1.2x over 2 minutes.

Priya R: good. next steps: keep fallback traffic for another 20m, monitor GPU utilization and KV evictions. If evictions don't drop, revert tokenizer change and open rollback PR.

Ethan K: leaving this on my watch for the next 30m, will escalate to infra if GPU stays pegged. tagging @infra.

Marta: writing a short post-incident note and will update stakeholders. Can someone grab the exact list of affected customer orgs from support logs?

Sam: grabbing support list now, will drop in #customer-impact in 2m.

Ethan K: handing off to Priya for long-running follow-up; I'll stay until 1722507345 and then mark PCC handoff. :thumbsup:

Priya R: acknowledged — taking rotation. I'll file INC-2024-873 with resolution notes after 30m observation and propose either a tokenizer revert or a smaller rollout slice.

Marta: thanks team. Summary for execs: brief spike due to v1.12 rollout causing KV churn + GPU hotpath contention; mitigated by scaling and 10% traffic fallback to v1.11-quant; customer impact limited but support tickets opened.

oncall-bot: Incident status: MONITORING. Next check-in in 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ethan K: closing my ack, leaving handoff note. If anything resurfaces, ping my phone.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: INC-2024-873 status=acknowledged, owner=Priya R, severity=high, escalation_policy=oncall-sre.
